scientific_independence.statement: Newly named successor study. It does not reopen or reuse inferential alpha from conditional-order v0.2/v0.3 or relational v0.3.

biological_question: Among species that genuinely share the same sampled geography, does post-IBD spatial genetic differentiation recur strongly enough that locations learned from other lineages predict an unseen lineage?

hypotheses.place_recurrence: Strongly codistributed lineages share a reusable geographic component of post-IBD spatial differentiation.
hypotheses.lineage_conditioned: Even among strongly codistributed lineages, within-species spatial structure is not predictably recurrent across unseen lineages.

codistribution_rule.spatial_object: frozen graph-edge midpoints in ECEF kilometres
codistribution_rule.directed_coverage: fraction of target edge midpoints whose nearest source edge midpoint is <=500 km
codistribution_rule.rule_role: eligibility/support definition only; it is not an empirical genetic response and is not compared against a looser source pool

estimator.target_response: endpoint-safe within-species post-IBD residual turnover on the inherited graph
estimator.prediction: 500-km Gaussian field fitted only from the target's codistributed training source species
estimator.source_weighting: equal total weight per selected source species, multiplied by N_train/N_selected so total pre-kernel source mass and prior influence remain comparable across targets
estimator.target_score: Spearman correlation between predicted edge exposure and observed target post-IBD turnover
estimator.primary_statistic: species-equal mean target score across response-blind supported evaluation species

qualification.private_null_type1_requirement: For every private cell, Wilson 95% upper bound of rejection rate at alpha=0.05 must be <=0.10.

positive_control.name: globally_shared_A2
positive_control.requirement: Wilson 95% lower bound of power must be >=0.80.

qualification.confirmatory_character_mask: Open canonical/noncanonical character masks only after development qualification. Remove failed species without graph repair, threshold change, or replacement.
qualification.survivor_requalification: Repeat exact private-null and shared-positive qualification on the confirmatory survivor geometry before nucleotide identity is opened.
qualification.failure_state: NOT_EVALUABLE; no empirical genetic response is opened.

interpretation_branches.positive: Among strongly codistributed lineages in the tested panel, post-IBD spatial differentiation contains a reusable place component.
interpretation_branches.qualified_non_detection: Even after requiring strong geographic co-distribution, no reusable place component is detected under the qualified test; this supports stronger lineage conditioning at the tested scale.

prohibited: compare same-order versus different-order source pools
select the codistribution threshold after genetic outcomes are viewed
inspect subgroup genetic scores to choose a favourable region, order, family or clade
change the 500-km radius, >=0.50 symmetric coverage rule or >=5-source rule after response opening
interpret post-IBD recurrence as direct proof of a named physical barrier
